performance.title: First Contentful Paint
performance.description: First Contentful Paint marks the time at which the first text or image is painted. [Learn more about the First Contentful Paint metric](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/lighthouse/performance/first-contentful-paint/).
performance.why: The first visible content is taking 2.9 s to appear. This can make the page feel slow when users first open it.
performance.fix: Reduce render-blocking CSS and JavaScript, optimize above-the-fold images, preload important resources, and remove unnecessary third-party scripts.

performance.title: Largest Contentful Paint
performance.description: Largest Contentful Paint marks the time at which the largest text or image is painted. [Learn more about the Largest Contentful Paint metric](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/lighthouse/performance/lighthouse-largest-contentful-paint/)
performance.why: The main visible content is taking 3.1 s to appear. A slow Largest Contentful Paint usually means the main image, heading, or other large element is loading too late.
performance.fix: Optimize the main hero image, use WebP or AVIF, preload the LCP resource when appropriate, reduce render-blocking resources, and defer non-critical JavaScript.

performance.title: Total Blocking Time
performance.description: Sum of all time periods between FCP and Time to Interactive, when task length exceeded 50ms, expressed in milliseconds. [Learn more about the Total Blocking Time metric](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/lighthouse/performance/lighthouse-total-blocking-time/).
performance.why: The browser is spending too much time executing long JavaScript tasks (260 ms). This delays user interaction.
performance.fix: Reduce JavaScript execution, remove unused JavaScript, split large bundles, defer non-critical scripts, and reduce third-party JavaScript.

performance.title: Speed Index
performance.description: Speed Index shows how quickly the contents of a page are visibly populated. [Learn more about the Speed Index metric](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/lighthouse/performance/speed-index/).
performance.why: Visible page content is appearing slowly (8.0 s), so users may see an incomplete page for longer.
performance.fix: Optimize above-the-fold images, reduce render-blocking resources, inline critical CSS, and defer non-critical assets.

performance.title: Use efficient cache lifetimes
performance.description: A long cache lifetime can speed up repeat visits to your page. [Learn more about caching](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/performance/insights/cache).

performance.fix: A long cache lifetime can speed up repeat visits to your page. [Learn more about caching](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/performance/insights/cache).

performance.title: Reduce unused CSS
performance.description: Reduce unused rules from stylesheets and defer CSS not used for above-the-fold content to decrease bytes consumed by network activity. [Learn how to reduce unused CSS](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/lighthouse/performance/unused-css-rules/).
performance.why: The page is downloading resources that are not fully used during the initial page load. This increases network and processing work.
performance.fix: Remove unused code, split CSS and JavaScript by page or feature, defer non-critical resources, and load assets only when they are needed.

performance.title: Avoid enormous network payloads

seo.title: Links are not crawlable
seo.description: Search engines may use `href` attributes on links to crawl websites. Ensure that the `href` attribute of anchor elements links to an appropriate destination, so more pages of the site can be discovered. [Learn how to make links crawlable](https://support.google.com/webmasters/answer/9112205)
seo.why: Some links may not be easily discoverable by search engines because they do not use crawlable link structures.
seo.fix: Use standard <a href="..."> links with valid destination URLs.

performance.description: First Contentful Paint marks the time at which the first text or image is painted. [Learn more about the First Contentful Paint metric](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/lighthouse/performance/first-contentful-paint/).
performance.why: The first visible content is taking 3.8 s to appear. This can make the page feel slow when users first open it.
performance.fix: Reduce render-blocking CSS and JavaScript, optimize above-the-fold images, preload important resources, and remove unnecessary third-party scripts.

performance.title: Largest Contentful Paint

performance.fix: Optimize the main hero image, use WebP or AVIF, preload the LCP resource when appropriate, reduce render-blocking resources, and defer non-critical JavaScript.

performance.why: The browser is spending too much time executing long JavaScript tasks (260 ms). This delays user interaction.
performance.fix: Reduce JavaScript execution, remove unused JavaScript, split large bundles, defer non-critical scripts, and reduce third-party JavaScript.

performance.title: First Contentful Paint
performance.description: First Contentful Paint marks the time at which the first text or image is painted. [Learn more about the First Contentful Paint metric](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/lighthouse/performance/first-contentful-paint/).
performance.why: The first visible content is taking 3.4 s to appear. This can make the page feel slow when users first open it.
performance.fix: Reduce render-blocking CSS and JavaScript, optimize above-the-fold images, preload important resources, and remove unnecessary third-party scripts.

performance.title: Largest Contentful Paint
performance.description: Largest Contentful Paint marks the time at which the largest text or image is painted. [Learn more about the Largest Contentful Paint metric](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/lighthouse/performance/lighthouse-largest-contentful-paint/)
performance.why: The main visible content is taking 3.6 s to appear. A slow Largest Contentful Paint usually means the main image, heading, or other large element is loading too late.
performance.fix: Optimize the main hero image, use WebP or AVIF, preload the LCP resource when appropriate, reduce render-blocking resources, and defer non-critical JavaScript.

performance.title: Total Blocking Time
performance.description: Sum of all time periods between FCP and Time to Interactive, when task length exceeded 50ms, expressed in milliseconds. [Learn more about the Total Blocking Time metric](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/lighthouse/performance/lighthouse-total-blocking-time/).
performance.why: The browser is spending too much time executing long JavaScript tasks (870 ms). This delays user interaction.
performance.fix: Reduce JavaScript execution, remove unused JavaScript, split large bundles, defer non-critical scripts, and reduce third-party JavaScript.

performance.title: Speed Index
performance.description: Speed Index shows how quickly the contents of a page are visibly populated. [Learn more about the Speed Index metric](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/lighthouse/performance/speed-index/).
performance.why: Visible page content is appearing slowly (6.2 s), so users may see an incomplete page for longer.
performance.fix: Optimize above-the-fold images, reduce render-blocking resources, inline critical CSS, and defer non-critical assets.

performance.title: First Contentful Paint
performance.description: First Contentful Paint marks the time at which the first text or image is painted. [Learn more about the First Contentful Paint metric](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/lighthouse/performance/first-contentful-paint/).
performance.why: The first visible content is taking 4.1 s to appear. This can make the page feel slow when users first open it.
performance.fix: Reduce render-blocking CSS and JavaScript, optimize above-the-fold images, preload important resources, and remove unnecessary third-party scripts.

performance.title: Largest Contentful Paint
performance.description: Largest Contentful Paint marks the time at which the largest text or image is painted. [Learn more about the Largest Contentful Paint metric](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/lighthouse/performance/lighthouse-largest-contentful-paint/)
performance.why: The main visible content is taking 4.1 s to appear. A slow Largest Contentful Paint usually means the main image, heading, or other large element is loading too late.
performance.fix: Optimize the main hero image, use WebP or AVIF, preload the LCP resource when appropriate, reduce render-blocking resources, and defer non-critical JavaScript.
